title: Old World Labs – A Website for Precision Manufacturing and Robotics
excerpt: How we built a modern web presence for Old World Labs, a precision manufacturing and robotics company pushing the boundaries of additive manufacturing, automation, and digital experiences.

blocks.text: Old World Labs operates at the intersection of advanced manufacturing, robotics, and immersive digital experiences. Founded by Nick Liverman in 2012, the company has grown from a precision 3D printing operation into a multi-disciplinary technology firm serving biotech, aerospace, automotive, and semiconductor industries.
They needed a website that matched the caliber of their work - technically sophisticated, visually clean, and fast.

Old World Labs offers three distinct service lines: advanced additive manufacturing at microscale precision, custom robotics and automation with AI-driven control systems, and Unreal Engine development for digital visualization. Communicating this range clearly - without diluting any single offering - was the core design challenge.
The website had to speak to decision-makers in highly technical industries while remaining accessible to potential partners and collaborators exploring new capabilities.

We designed and developed a modern, performance-first website that gives each service line its own space while maintaining a cohesive brand experience. The site is built on Next.js with static generation, ensuring fast load times and strong SEO performance.

Key decisions included a dark-mode-first design language that reflects the precision engineering brand, structured service pages that let technical audiences go deep, and a lightweight architecture that loads fast on any device.
The site is deployed on a global edge network, delivering sub-second load times regardless of visitor location - important for a company with clients across multiple continents.

Old World Labs now has a digital presence that accurately represents their technical capabilities. The website serves as both a credibility tool for enterprise sales conversations and a discovery channel for new partnerships.
The site scales effortlessly - new service pages, [case studies](/case-studies), and product announcements can be added without architectural changes.

"I've worked with Sebastian for several years. He consistently delivers [high-quality](/blog/what-makes-a-good-business-website) work under tight deadlines. Reliable, professional, and always a step ahead." - N. Liverman, Founder of Old World Labs
